'''Daz''' was a bald [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]].

==Biography==
Daz was the father of [[Linia]] and, by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], was in his late forties. He owned and operated [[Daz's Tavern]], a tavern that was located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]], on Dalicron-4.
